empty.resourcesDescription: Connect data, tools, and automations in one place.
empty.noResourcesDescription: Create a resource to make shared data and capabilities available to your workspace.
empty.noSearchResultsDescription: Try another keyword or clear the search to see every resource.
empty.name: Name
empty.noFilterResultsDescription: Clear the filters to see every resource.
empty.customMediaBody: EmptyMedia accepts any React content. Render a sanitized uploaded image with variant="custom"; storage, permissions, and upload validation stay outside Empty.
empty.noDocumentsDescription: Upload a document to make it available to your workspace.
empty.illustrationsBody: Seven quiet, theme-aware SVGs cover common zero-data contexts. The preview variant can perspective-map an icon or image onto its front card.
empty.usageBody: Use Empty only after a successful response confirms that no content matches the current scope. Reason records why the state exists; scope records how much product UI it replaces.
empty.loadingBody: Resolve loading, request errors, permissions, and setup requirements before Empty. A failed request must never appear as no data.
empty.actionBody: Actions are optional. When present, keep one primary action and at most one secondary action; each action should fill the space or remove the condition that made it empty.
empty.accessibilityBody: Static empty states are silent by default. Keep the page heading, table header, search controls, and filters available so the state remains understandable in context.
empty.announcementBody: Set announce for a dynamic search or filter result. Empty then creates a polite status region; do not use it for an initial page render.
empty.mediaAccessibilityBody: EmptyMedia treats visuals as decorative by default. Set decorative=false only when custom media communicates information that the title and description do not already provide.
empty.reasonProp: The confirmed reason content is absent. It is exposed as data-reason for styling, tests, and instrumentation.
empty.scopeProp: Page replaces a primary content area, section fills a bounded panel, and inline sits inside a table or compact data surface.
empty.densityProp: Adjusts vertical rhythm independently from semantic scope.
empty.alignProp: Controls text and child alignment. Start is useful for educational page-level states.
empty.announceProp: Adds role=status and aria-live=polite unless the consumer supplies explicit ARIA values.
empty.mediaPart: Optional icon, built-in illustration, uploaded image, or custom visual. Decorative by default.
empty.headerPart: Width-constrained group for title and description.
empty.titlePart: Required concise statement of the empty result. Choose a heading level that follows the surrounding page structure.
empty.descriptionPart: Optional explanation and useful next step, ideally one or two sentences.
empty.contentPart: Optional search, upload, template, shortcut, or filled-state preview area.
empty.actionsPart: Flexible action row for one primary and an optional secondary action.
empty.illustrationPart: Theme-aware general, resources, preview, search, filter, inbox, and analytics SVG variants. Preview accepts perspective-mapped media.
